description: Lists customers from mite, active ones or with `archived: true` the archived ones; use it to look up customer ids for filters such as `customer_id` in `mite_list_time_entries`. Returns id, name, archived flag and note per customer. The whole list is returned at once without paging.

archived.description: true = list archived entries instead of the active ones, e.g. true. Default: false.

name: mite_list_customers
title: List customers
